added: A shared dance or program file carries the new figures of your own its dances use, each one's name, description, parameters and wording, but not your notes on it.
changed: A shared file made by a newer version of the app is no longer refused: the import review opens it, imports what this version understands, and says that some details may be left out.

added: `CompendiumArchive.userFigures` and the share-mode `userFigures` section (`archiveUserFigureToJson`, `decodeArchiveUserFigures`, bounded by `kMaxArchiveUserFigures`), written without a schema version bump (#1023).
